details: The order-shattered sets are shattered sets.
name: Largest Shattered Set / Minimum Largest Order Shattered Set
proof: Every order-shattered set is shattered, so the largest size of a shattered set is at least the corresponding order-shattering parameter.
witness_verification: On the addressing family, VC dimension is floor(log_2 n), whereas the bit-first coordinate order has largest order-shattered set size one, so OSH_min=1. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound can hold; sync/verify_addressing_order_shattering.py checks the downshifting calculation.
